chunks: 1022 - It is narrated from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from al-ʿAbd al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who doubts and does not know whether he has prayed one, two, three, or four; his salat becomes confused for him. So he said: “All of that.”
So I said: “Yes.” He said: “Then let him continue in his salat and seek refuge in Allah from al-Shayṭān al-Rajīm, for it is likely that it will go away from him.”

key_terms.تَلْتَبِسُ: it becomes confused or mixed up

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he becomes confused about how many rakʿahs he has prayed?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a case of doubt in salat when a person becomes confused about the number of rakʿahs prayed. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to continue his prayer and to seek refuge in Allah from al-Shayṭān al-Rajīm, indicating that such confusion may pass away.
